issues.description: Tracker SQL updated-at sort key is coalesce(c.updated_at, c.created_at) while serializeMergedWorkItem/serializeUpdatedAt falls back to done_at ?? started_at ?? created_at when updated_at is NULL. The displayed updatedAt is the same serializer as /work-items, so API values are consistent, but the SQL order and the cursor (built from the serialized value) diverge for a column-less row with NULL updated_at and done_at/started_at set. Migrated and Tracker-created rows always have updated_at, so this is latent. Fix: use coalesce(c.updated_at, c.done_at, c.started_at, c.created_at) for the tracker branch (and update the pagination assertions).
